title: Shimon HaShikmoni, a Tanna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a disciple of Rabbi Akiva (Bava Batra 119a). Rabbi Chadka said: Shimon HaShikmani was a colleague of mine, one of Rabbi Akiva's disciples. And thus Rabbi Shimon HaShikmoni used to say: Moses our teacher knew that the daughters of Tzelofchad were heirs, but he did not know whether they take a firstborn's portion or not. And the passage on inheritances was fit to have been written through Moses, but the daughters of Tzelofchad merited it — to teach you that merit is brought about through a meritorious person, etc.

notes.text: Shikmani and Shikmoni are preserved as the source’s name forms.
